summary: Iter 60 — ProfilePage + Enterprise ROI Calculator + Sidebar nav tested end-to-end. 10/12 backend tests PASS. Frontend: /profile renders perfectly for accelerator tier (all 9 new testids + activity feed + tabs + dimension scores), edit flow saves + toast + bio persists across reload, referrals navigation works, enterprise ROI strip + calculator + sliders all render. 1 real backend data-flow bug found (community post creation does not write activity_log), and 1 frontend UI bug (ProfilePage LEVEL_META uses outdated English level names — fails for migrated German levels).

critical.issue: Creating a community post does NOT insert into activity_log nor award XP. /api/profile/activity feed will never show community_post entries. Root cause: routes/community.py create_post() only does db.community_posts.insert_one() and never calls update_user_scores() (defined in services.py:202). Other routes (challenge30, checkin, simulations, deep_assist, referral) DO call update_user_scores and correctly populate activity_log. Spec explicitly lists 'community_post' as an expected action key in routes/profile.py ACTION_META.

minor.issue: 'updated' count in response includes the internally-added 'updated_at' field, so a 3-field patch returns updated=4 with fields=[...,'updated_at']. Consider excluding updated_at from the count/fields array so the response matches user intent.

ui_bugs.issue: LEVEL_META only contains English level names (Emerging Leader/Capable Leader/Confident Leader/Strategic Leader/Visionary Leader), but backend startup migration (server.py:110-126) now rewrites all users to German role names (Teamplayer/Mentor/Kommunikator/Strategischer Denker/Visionär). Result: for a user with level='Visionär' and 2521 XP, the progress bar shows 'Nächstes Level: Capable Leader' at thresholds 0→200 XP which is totally wrong (see screenshot — accelerator user). The LEVEL_META object should be keyed by the German role names OR an i18n mapping layer should be added.

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/backend/routes/community.py create_post(): call await update_user_scores(user_id, action='community_post', xp_delta=<e.g. 10>, metadata={'post_id': post['post_id']}) after inserting the post, so (a) user earns XP, (b) activity_log gets populated, (c) /api/profile/activity returns the new post as most recent entry. This is the spec'd data-flow.

HIGH: Update LEVEL_META in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.js:29 to match the German role-based level names the backend actually returns (Teamplayer, Mentor, Kommunikator, Strategischer Denker, Visionär). Without this, every user sees a wrong 'next level' label + wrong XP thresholds.

MINOR: In /app/backend/routes/profile.py PATCH /me, either don't add updated_at to the dict before counting, OR subtract it from the returned count/fields array so the response reflects only user-provided fields.
critical_code_review_comments: community.py is silently missing the activity_log + XP integration that every other action route has — this is a systemic gap. Consider a middleware/decorator or a central `record_user_action(user_id, action, xp, metadata)` helper so routes can't forget.

ProfilePage.js LEVEL_META constants are decoupled from backend's LEVEL_THRESHOLDS. Suggestion: expose a GET /api/profile/levels endpoint that returns the authoritative list so the frontend stays in sync.
profile.py _within_last_days() swallows all exceptions with bare except — not ideal; at least log.

ProfilePage.js line 256: joinedYears uses member_since = '' default which Date.parse() returns NaN. Math.floor(NaN) = NaN — might render 'NaN+ Jahre'. Should guard with isNaN check (currently masked because member_since is always set).

EnterpriseROICalculator computes roiPct using investmentAssumed = teamSize * 2497, but /app/backend/routes/payments.py enterprise pricing is not €2,497/seat — this is a made-up marketing figure. Should either cite the source or be dynamic from packages config.

rca_of_the_issue: community_post flow bug: /api/community/posts route (routes/community.py:53) inserts the post document but never calls the shared update_user_scores() helper (services.py:202) that is responsible for (a) awarding XP, (b) updating leadership_score/eq_score/communication_score, (c) inserting into activity_log (line 233). Every other action route in the codebase (daily_checkin, challenge30 day completion, simulations, deep_assist, referral_success, etc.) does call it. Fix is a 2-line addition after db.community_posts.insert_one. Level-Progress bug: server.py:111-122 migrates legacy levels to German role names at startup, but the frontend LEVEL_META constant in ProfilePage.js was never updated to reflect those names, causing a silent fallback to 'Emerging Leader' meta which renders wrong next-level and thresholds.
